section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 2. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 43 | 250 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 31 | 250 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
